_comment: Dinner Time drinks. 'prep' is how the drink is made: 'grab' (take from the fridge, instant), 'pour' (hold to fill to the line), or 'brew' (start it, wait a moment, then pour). 'unlock' is 'start' or 'upgrade' (bought at end of day for unlock_cost). Prices are in coins.

drinks.name: Water
drinks.description: A glass of cold water. Always free.
